body.p: This listing of claims reflects all claim amendments and replaces all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application. Material to be inserted is in bold and underline, and material to be deleted is in strikeout or in [[double brackets]] if the deletion would be difficult to see.

br.br:
1. (Currently amended) A system, comprising:an input;
an output;
a first software component for use in configuring operation of a second software component via a proxy and stub interface;
a non-transitory memory component comprising:a first memory space comprising the first software component, a proxy software component and an activity monitor software component;and
a second memory space comprising the second software component and a stub software component; and
at least one processor for executing software components stored on the first and second memory spaces,
wherein the activity monitor software component is arranged when executed to:
cause the input to monitor a first event associated with the first software component;
cause the input to monitor a second event associated with the proxy software component, wherein the second event includes a command event at the proxy software component;
Docket No. JLR213134PCTUSCON1 assess compliance of the first and second events with a schedule of events,
wherein assessing compliance includes checking order and/or timing of the first and second events; andcause the output to generate an error message in response to assessed non-compliance with the schedule of events.
2. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the schedule of events includes timing and/or order of the events.
3. (Original) The system of claim 1, further comprising a data store partitioned into the first memory space and the second memory space.
4. (Original) The system of claim 1, further comprising a first data store comprising the first memory space and a second data store comprising the second memory space.
5. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the system is a vehicle system.
6. (Original) The system of claim 5, wherein the vehicle system is a cruise control system.
7. (Original) The system of claim 5, wherein the second software component comprises a drivetrain component.
8. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the first software component comprises a logic component arranged to generate a command event to control the second software component based on an input event.
9. (Original) The system of claim 8, wherein the input event comprises a sensor reading obtained from a sensor component.
10. (Currently amended) The system of claim 9, wherein the sensor component is a wheel speed sensor component.
11. (Original) The system of claim 9, wherein the input event is obtained in response to a polling event initiated by the logic component.
12. (Currently amended) The system of claim 11, wherein the first event associated with the first software component is selected from a list including the input event, the polling event, and the command event.
13. (Original) The system of claim 1, further comprising a troubleshooting component arranged to treat an error in response to receiving the error message.
14. (Original) A vehicle comprising the system of claim 4.
15. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the proxy software component is arranged to marshal the command event and route the command event to a corresponding stub on the second memory space.
Application Filing Date: May 28, 2021
16. (Currently amended) The system of claim 15, wherein the corresponding stub is arranged to route the command event to a powertrain component.
17. (Previously presented) The system of claim 15, wherein the powertrain component is an engine control unit, and further wherein any torque demands received are used to configure a motor to output a desired output torque.
18. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the proxy software component is arranged to marshal additional command events and route each command event to a target location on another memory space.
19. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the activity monitor software component is arranged to monitor polling events and comparison events.
20. (Previously presented) The system of claim 19, wherein the assessed non- compliance includes a determination that one of the polling events occurred after one of the comparison events.
